purpose: Provides utility functions for generating and manipulating synthetic network topologies, including Fat-Tree, line, and random graphs. It also includes helper functions for enforcing graph constraints and modifying node degrees, as well as a decorator for runtime attribute validation.

internal: usecase_config (indirect via config access in makeLineGraph and makeRandomGraph)

purpose: Decorator that enforces the existence of a required attribute on an instance before executing a method. It is used for runtime validation of object state, ensuring that dependent computations are only executed when prerequisite attributes are initialized.
preconditions: Wrapped method belongs to a class instance
Attribute name provided exists or is expected to exist on instance
postconditions: Raises ValueError if required attribute is missing or None

returns.description: Wrapped function with runtime attribute validation

purpose: Generates a k-ary Fat-Tree network topology using NetworkX. The topology consists of core, aggregation, edge switches, and hosts, with hierarchical structured connectivity suitable for data center network modeling.
preconditions: k must be a positive integer
postconditions: Returns a graph with Fat-Tree structure
Nodes include switches (core, aggregation, edge) and hosts

returns.description: Fat-tree topology graph (directed or undirected depending on flag)

purpose: Creates a linear chain topology of switches and attaches hosts to random or boundary switches. Used for simple pipeline-like network structures.
preconditions: config must contain numhosts and numswitchs fields
postconditions: All switches are connected in a chain

returns.description: Line topology graph with host attachments

example_usage.setup:
from utils import makeLineGraph
from usecase_config import UsecaseConfig

purpose: Generates a random network topology using graph models such as Waxman, Barabási–Albert, or Erdős–Rényi. Ensures minimum node degree constraints and attaches host nodes to switches.
preconditions: config must contain topology_config with graph parameters

example_usage.setup:
from utils import makeRandomGraph
from usecase_config import UsecaseConfig

purpose: Adjusts the degree of a node in the graph by either adding or removing edges to meet a required target degree. Used to enforce topology constraints in random graph generation.
postconditions: Node degree is adjusted toward newDegree
side_effects: Adds or removes edges in graph
